name: Speedyt
tagline: Ad-free speed test for your TV.
summary: Download, upload and latency, then what your line can handle.

highlights.label: SPEED
highlights.title: Download, upload, ping, jitter
highlights.text: Measured on Cloudflare's network, from the TV itself.

highlights.label: LOAD
highlights.title: Latency under load, graded A to D
highlights.text: The bufferbloat grade shows if the line stays responsive.

highlights.label: VERDICT
highlights.title: What the line handles
highlights.text: 4K and 1080p streams, HD calls and gaming, in plain numbers.

highlights.label: LINK
highlights.title: Ethernet or Wi-Fi, explained
highlights.text: Wi-Fi band, signal, link rates and tips when the TV limits you.

highlights.label: REMOTE
highlights.title: Built for the sofa
highlights.text: Dark theme, large type, full D-pad control. EN, ES, RU.

highlights.label: PRIVATE
highlights.title: No ads, accounts or tracking
highlights.text: The last 50 results stay on the TV and nowhere else.
